about: Citation marker grammar shared by the Rust verifier (harness/grounding/citations.rs) and the transcript renderer (app/src/features/agent/grounding.ts). `markers` lists each marker's numbers in order of appearance.

cases.text: An interval [0, 1] is not a citation.
A link [3](https://example.org) is not a citation.
Code `x[1]` is code; this [2] is not.

```
let y = v[7];
```
After the fence [8].
A KAN of shape [4, 9, 1] is a tuple.
Out of order [5, 2] is a tuple.
